cohort: 157 pregnant women with hyperglycemia at a gestational age between 24 and 32 weeks who underwent a 75g 2-hour glucose tolerance test at PNS Shifa Hospital, Karachi.
finding: Neonatal hyperbilirubinemia was observed in 10.2% of newborns born to mothers with hyperglycemia.
gest_age: 24-32 weeks at time of testing, mean 37.11 +/- 3.22 weeks at delivery
